(
	fs = i/fs
	stdio = i/stdio
	process = i/process
	fail = i/fail
	bit_array = i/bit_array
	json = i/json
)

main = () {
	args = process.args()
	args |>
		([manifest_path, destination_path]) {
			manifest_result = fail.catch(() { fs.read_file(manifest_path) })
			manifest_result |>
				(Ok(manifest_bytes)) {
					bit_array.to_string(manifest_bytes) |>
						(Ok(manifest_text)) {
							json.parse(manifest_text) |>
								(Ok(json.Array(source_paths))) {
									run(source_paths, destination_path)
								}
								& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
						}
						& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
				}
				& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
		}
		& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
}

run = (source_paths, destination_path) {
	lock_path = destination_path <> ".lock"
	part_path = destination_path <> ".part"
	fail.catch(() { fs.mkdir(lock_path) }) |>
		(Ok(_)) {
			result = fail.catch(() {
				fs.write_file(part_path, <<>>)
				bytes = append_sources(source_paths, part_path, 0)
				fs.rename(part_path, destination_path)
				bytes
			})
			fs.remove(part_path)
			fs.remove(lock_path)
			result |>
				(Ok(count)) { stdio.print("OK " <> core.inspect(count)) }
				& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
		}
		& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR") }
}

append_sources = (paths, part_path, count) {
	paths |>
		([]) { count }
		& ([path, ..rest]) {
			bytes = fs.read_file(path)
			fs.write_file(part_path, bytes)
			append_sources(rest, part_path, count + bit_array.byte_size(bytes))
		}
}
